Learn about our services

Interior & exterior protection, one team

At NorthWest Exterminators, we aim to provide you with the best service and ensure that you and your needs always come first. With a professional and trustworthy staff, your satisfaction is guaranteed.

Interior Services

Ant Removal & Prevention

Ants located at the source, removed, and kept out — with prevention that stops the next trail before it starts.

Spider Control

Spiders cleared from living spaces, basements, and crawl spaces — safely and thoroughly.

Rodent Removal & Prevention

Rats and mice removed from your home, with prevention work that keeps them from coming back.

Exterior Services

Wasps, Yellow Jackets & Hornets

Removal and prevention of stinging insects around your home. Bee concerns are referred to local bee keepers.

Exterior Rodent Control

Rodents stopped outside — before they find their way into your attic, walls, or crawl space.

Ant Eviction

Exterior ant colonies evicted from foundations, patios, and garden beds around your home.
